relationships.subject: AIBP
relationships.evidence_quote: Apolipoprotein A-I binding protein (AIBP) binds to TLR4 and promotes cholesterol depletion and lipid raft disruption in cells where TLR4 is expressed.

relationships.subject: AIBP
relationships.evidence_quote: whole-cell recordings show that disruption of TLR4-rafts with AIBP inhibited pain-associated ectopic action potential generation and evoked neuronal excitation in hDRG neurons

relationships.subject: lipid rafts
relationships.evidence_quote: This increased density of TLR4-lipid rafts results in increased excitability of hDRG TRPV1 receptors.

key_findings: TLR4-lipid rafts are denser in pain-associated human DRG and localize to TRPV1 neurons
AIBP disrupted TLR4 rafts and reduced ectopic action potentials and evoked excitation in hDRG neurons
